title: Book One · Chapter 31: The Blue Tail
story:
Mum comes to the classroom with a sewing bag on her arm. She is a little late because a customer came to collect a repaired skirt.

Ronan sees her at the door and lifts both hands. Then he puts one hand back on the kite so it won't fall off the table.

"You found the bird road," he says.

"I asked the bird. It was very quiet."

Leo's father stands at the other side. He wears a dark work shirt. Leo shows him the frame first. "Ronan's dad made these strips smooth," he says.

"Our hands did this knot," Leo says, pointing carefully. "Mr Qiu showed us the other one."

Mum looks at the blue tail. She touches the pale piece. It came from her cloth bag.

"I know that bit."

"We moved it to the middle," Ronan tells her.

"Does it fly now?"

"We still need to try it with the new line."

Mum nods. She does not get angry at the answer. Ronan puts the tail down and shows her the new line.

Jun brings his mother over to see the kite. He walks with his windmill. The paper turns. Miss Wu asks him to stand in one clear place so the paper won't catch other people's faces.

Jun shows Ronan the green wheel. One side still jumps.

"I kept that bit," he says. "It turns anyway."

Ronan shows him the meeting knot. Jun doesn't ask for a kite. "Will the line pull the paper off?" he asks.

Ronan looks closely. There is a folded paper patch under one point. One edge is lifting.

"Maybe that needs more paste," he says.

Mum puts down her bag. Ronan calls Leo before she can help. The boys carry the kite to the making table. Miss Wu gives them a little paste and says they must leave it flat until it dries. The blue tail stays clear of the wet place.

"Is the kite finished?" Leo's father asks.

"The making part is nearly done," Leo says. "The flying part isn't."

While they wait, Mum goes to see Mei's garden. Mei points to one flower. "I made this one up," she says. Mei drew square parts on one flower. She likes squares.

Ronan watches Mum listen. He wanted Mum beside him the whole time. But she wants to see Mei's work, too. Ronan stays at his table. Leo is there to help him.

Near the end, Dad appears at the door. He carries no tools, only his cap. A neighbour's repair took longer than Dad planned. Now he has ten minutes free. He came straight from work.

Ronan runs to him. Then he remembers the kite must not be lifted.

"You can see it lying down."

"I like lying down after work too," Dad says.

They go to the table. Ronan tells him about the wet paper, the returned coin, and the two new lines. Dad already knows some of it. Now Ronan shows him the new lines. Dad listens.

It is time to leave. Miss Wu asks every child for help. Each child carries one safe thing back. The boys carry their kite between them. Mum carries the paste pot. Dad carries the spare board under his arm.

At home, they lay everything on the table. The tail is straight. The patch is flat. Leo will come tomorrow for a test at the drying yard.

Ronan adds one line to the card: NEXT TRY, THURSDAY.

He shows the card to Leo. They will try again tomorrow. Will the kite go up? Will it go high? They will see tomorrow.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：straight＝直的；patch＝补片；paste＝浆糊；dries＝变干。

理解问题：

1. Mum 和 Dad 各自怎样参与了展示？
2. Ronan 向来访者说了哪些真实情况？
